# Command reference

JSON mode writes one stable envelope to stdout and is the default when stdout is not a TTY. Text, raw, and help output are explicitly selected exceptions. Network commands require an explicit `--profile`; there is no active or default profile. See `contract.md` for exit codes and envelopes.

## Global flags

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | bool | preview a supported local change |
| `--fields` | stringSlice | comma-separated fields to emit |
| `-o, --output` | string | output format: text, json, or raw |
| `--profile` | string | named Redmine profile (required for every network command) |
| `--timeout` | duration | abort the command after this duration |
| `-v, --verbose` | bool | write redacted request activity to stderr |
| `--yes` | bool | confirm a local overwrite or destructive action |

## Commands

### `redmine-cli auth list`

List non-secret profile metadata without reading Keychain

No flags of its own.

### `redmine-cli auth login`

Verify and store one profile token

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--token-stdin` | bool |  | read one bounded API token from stdin |
| `--url` | string |  | canonical Redmine HTTPS base URL |

### `redmine-cli auth logout`

Delete one profile token and metadata

No flags of its own.

### `redmine-cli auth status`

Show profile metadata and optionally verify it against Redmine

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | bool |  | verify the stored token with a network request |

### `redmine-cli contract`

Print the machine-readable envelope and exit-code contract

No flags of its own.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### `redmine-cli issues list`

List one bounded page of issues with explicit filters

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--assigned-to` | string |  | me or a numeric user ID |
| `--created-on` | string |  | Redmine created_on filter expression |
| `--cursor` | string |  | opaque next_cursor from a previous matching call |
| `--include` | stringSlice |  | associations: attachments,relations |
| `--limit` | int | `25` | maximum issues in this page (1-100) |
| `--project-id` | string |  | numeric Redmine project ID |
| `--sort` | string | `updated_on:desc` | comma-separated allowlisted sort fields |
| `--status` | string | `open` | open, closed, *, or a numeric status ID |
| `--tracker-id` | string |  | numeric tracker ID |
| `--updated-on` | string |  | Redmine updated_on filter expression |
